reply_text:
Open the Build 2020 transcript, the Ignite 2020 transcript and the Bio-IT World piece.I found no dated AI predictions from Satya Nadella in 2020. I read two of his 2020 keynote transcripts. Neither had a statement about AI that names a year or a length of time, or says when AGI arrives.

**What I read**
- **Ignite keynote, 22 September 2020 (Microsoft's official transcript):** The AI parts look back at what has happened or describe products. One part comes close but fails the test. It is a vision for Dynamics 365 that opens as a hypothetical ("what if AI could truly understand customers' requests…") and gives no date. The only time span in the speech ("in the coming years") is about satellite data, not AI.
- **Build keynote, 19 May 2020 (Rev transcript):** The page cut off partway through. The part I read talks about AI tools and the "AI supercomputer in the cloud" but predicts nothing with a date. I didn't see the rest of the speech.
- **Yahoo Finance interview, about January 2020** (headline: "I really would love for the 2020s to be defined differently"): Only the opening paragraphs loaded and they contain nothing usable, so I quote nothing from it.

**Not checked**
- The Bio-IT World report from 30 November 2020 wouldn't open.
- Nadella's October 2020 shareholder letter ("Our opportunity to define the world we want to live in") showed up in my last search, after I'd used all my page openings. This is the best remaining lead. My dating of it comes from the search tool's "days ago" figure (about 2168), not from the page.
- His Future Decoded talks in India (24–25 February 2020) appeared only in news reports.

**Lead from another year:** the LinkedIn essay "A cloud built for the next decade" dates from 2 March 2021 (worked out from the post's ID), so it belongs under 2021.

**My mistakes:** I wasted one page opening by loading the Ignite speech page twice after a parsing error. The first opening worked, but I didn't keep what it returned. That's why the shareholder letter went unchecked.
